'''Alkindar''' is a town in [[Altara]], located on west bank of the [[River Eldar]] on the [[Great North Road]], between [[Ebou Dar]] and [[Lugard]].

Alkindar has a companion town called [[Coramen]], which is on the east bank of the Eldar. There is a ferry that connects the two towns. When [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]] is traveling through Altara, they pass through Alkindar and take the ferry across to Coramen. Despite the heavy presence of [[Seanchan]] troops on both sides of the river, [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] keeps her word to [[Matrim Cauthon]] not to betray them.{{ref/book|10|28}}
